page.layout: Two columns of index entries under the heading INDEX: left column T (top), right column V (top) with W below it at the right; FINIS centred below the columns. A printer's mark (signature) at bottom left. No page number or running head.

main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: TENTATIONIS finis 6.10.163. vt ea liberemur, orandum ibid.
Tertullianus permittit Idolo adstare, in officio Politico 4.18.126. eius error in fuga vetanda 5.6.134. libros facit contra Ecclesiam. ibid.
Toleratio non facit res legitimas 2.11. 69. tolerat peccata Deus, & quare. 6.5.156
Transfuga Angli iurarunt in Principis supremum Dominium. 4.10. 116
Tridentinum Concilium quid egerit de templo in Anglia adeundo. 4.7. 111.
Tsippora impedit circumcisionem 2.1. 56. ipsa postea circumcidit 2.2.57 imitanda non est 2.8.89
VAlens ex Astrologorum pronunciatis multos occidit. 3.12.94
Valentinianus aditum cædit 4.17.125 est Iuliano Apostata Tribunus, & ab eodem relegatur ibid.

page.notes: The T and V initials are large woodcut-style capitals joined to their words. The "Wilburnus" W is a large decorated initial. The signature at bottom left is an unclear printer's mark, read as γ[?]. The text in the index is set with dot leaders omitted in the scan. Some numbers in the scan (e.g. "2.6 62", "2.11. 69") appear with spacing as printed.
